prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 86.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 30.6%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].

"layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Personality Traits Selector
candidates.change: Redesign the pet choice screen into a split view with dynamic trait selection cards and active pet animation previews.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.7% with a high mean time of 1017s; structured trait picks make pet selection fast and engaging.

candidates.title: Account Recovery & Existing Pet Lookup Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated account lookup screen before sign in to search and verify previously created pets on cloud storage.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

new_account_lookup.headline: Find Your Existing Pets
new_account_lookup.body: Enter your account email to locate previously saved desktop companions before logging in.

candidates.title: Live Desktop Environment Calibration Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a desktop environment calibration step right after pet generation to verify desktop bounds and screen rendering.
candidates.why: Home step mean time is 2336s and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show on desktop screens.

new_desktop_calibration.headline: Calibrating Desktop Bounds
new_desktop_calibration.body: Testing screen overlay rendering areas so your pet lands safely on your desktop.

candidates.title: Onboarding Celebration & Desktop Launch Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated desktop launch ceremony screen immediately before completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 68.7% conversion with mean duration of 5815s; a explicit launch milestone prompts final completion.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Your pet is officially ready to explore your screen.

new_desktop_launch_ceremony.headline: Release Pet to Desktop
new_desktop_launch_ceremony.body: Click to launch your new companion onto your screen now!

candidates.title: Path Decision Quick Summary Callout
candidates.change: Update the choose_path text to explicitly call out estimated times for express adoption versus custom creation.
candidates.why: choose_path has a median duration of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating decision hesitation for long-tail users.

choose_path.headline: Pick Your Pet Journey
choose_path.body: Choose Express Adoption (1 min) or Custom Creation (3 mins) to start.
choose_path.hint: You can always create more pets later from your desktop tray.

candidates.title: Sign-In Freeze Prevention Notice
candidates.change: Display a fallback troubleshooting hint on the sign-in screen if sign-in fails or freezes.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets reported that the sign-in screen stalls or fails to load.

sign_in.hint: Screen taking too long? Click refresh or sign in as guest to restore your pet later.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Styling Diagnostic Guidelines
candidates.change: Add photo lighting and angle guidance badges directly on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or generating incorrect models.

upload_photos.headline: Upload High Quality Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Ensure well-lit, front-facing photos for best 3D pet generation results.

candidates.title: Desktop Tray Icon Visibility Alert
candidates.change: Show an image hint during the waiting stage pointing to the system tray controls location.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported user confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.

waiting.hint: Look for the pet icon in your system tray (bottom right) to manage pet visibility anytime.

candidates.title: First Day Starter Item Reward Banner
candidates.change: Display an unlocked gift badge on the welcome intro screen rewarding users for finishing onboarding.
candidates.why: Finish step completion is 68.7%; offering an immediate reward encourages users to complete setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Arrived with a Gift!
home_intro.body: You unlocked the Free Starter Toy Pack! Find it in your desktop pet menu.

candidates.title: Compact Choice Split View Layout
candidates.change: Change choose_path screen layout to split view to present path choices side-by-side cleanly.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is high (514s); side-by-side presentation streamlines path selection.

choose_path.headline: Choose Express or Custom Pet
choose_path.body: Compare path features side-by-side and dive right in.
